colors.identity: authoritative navy with restrained brass accent
colors.light: warm cool-gray workspace with crisp white operational surfaces
colors.dark: deep ink workspace with lifted navy surfaces

motion.character: short functional transitions with reduced-motion support

must: Preserve Vue 3, Vuetify, API contracts, permissions, i18n and RTL
Use real backend data and supported routes only
Keep status meaning textual and keyboard focus visible
avoid: Decorative dashboard charts without real data
Excessive gradients, glass effects or motion
Static navigation that bypasses backend permissions

decisions.name: Operational Clarity
decisions.reason: Balances executive confidence with high-frequency ERP density through a dark navigation anchor, quiet canvas, crisp operational surfaces and restrained brand accent.

decisions.name: Executive Canvas
decisions.reason: More spacious and presentation-led, but too low-density for all-day operational work.

decisions.name: Dense Command Center
decisions.reason: Maximizes scanning speed, but creates too much cognitive load for mixed-experience users and mobile.
